text: On August 3, 2017, the owner of the property at 80 Bloor Street West appealed its Zoning By-law Amendment application to the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal (LPAT) due to Council's failure to enact the requested amendment within the time allotted by the Planning Act. On November 1, 2019 a new Official Plan Amendment (OPA) application (File No. 20 244311 STE 11 OZ) was submitted for an expanded site to include 82 Bloor Street West. Accompanying the new OPA for 80-82 Bloor Street West was a revised Zoning By-law Amendment application for the expanded site. On June 5, 2020, the Zoning By-law Amendment application was revised again, and the OPA application (File No. 20 244311 STE 11 OZ) was withdrawn. City Council on July 28 and 29, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the City Solicitor, together with City Planning staff and other City staff, to attend the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal hearing to oppose the Zoning By-law amendment (File 13 248425 STE 27 OZ) application as proposed. 2. City Council direct the City Solicitor and appropriate City staff to continue discussions with the applicant with an aim to resolve the issues identified in the report (June 25, 2020) from the Director, Community Planning, Toronto and East York District. 3. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the supplementary report (July 29, 2020) from the City Solicitor, as amended by the confidential attachment to motion 1 by Councillor Mike Layton. 4.
